content.comment_body: Hello, I am facing an issue with the [product_name] web editor. When attempting to upload to the [product_name], I receive an error: FW version validation failed. How can I resolve this? My [product_name] version is [article_no]. I searched for a firmware update but haven’t found any.

Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. Currently, no firmware update is available. The latest firmware version for the [product_name] is [version_no]. Which [product_name] web editor version are you using?
The latest [product_name] hardware requires the web editor version [version_no]. This explains the meaning of the error message.

You can download the latest version of the web editor ([version_no]) from here: [url]. Note that this software has export restrictions. Why does downloading export-restricted software require login, registration, and what information is needed?

analysis.insight_summary: The main difficulty users face is an incompatibility between software and hardware versions, resulting in a confusing error message. There is uncertainty due to the absence of firmware updates and lack of clear communication regarding the source of the error.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect better compatibility and transparent error messaging between [product_name] web editor and hardware, along with straightforward access to updates or solutions.
